WITH latest_eod AS (SELECT * FROM market.equity_eod WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)),

template_1.description: Calculate index returns over the last 3 months.
template_1.query: WITH latest_index AS (SELECT index_symbol, close FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.index_eod)) SELECT index_symbol, ((close / (SELECT close FROM market.index_eod WHERE index_symbol = latest_index.index_symbol AND trade_date = (SELECT MIN(trade_date) FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'))) - 1) * 100 AS three_month_return FROM latest_index;
